slopes.wireLayout: SL2: Uint16 shared grid, sparse four-corner overrides, explicit cliff and N/E/S/W discontinuity planes
slopes.note: Finite home-rooted field-coordinate certificate over 48x48 chunks; crop edges never imply access. Collision resolves the Uint16 grid plus tile overrides and edge flags, independently of projection and cover. Starting generated range 0..15 levels; no clipping. Bare bytes include the undressed WorldChunk protobuf and framed SL2 envelope; dressing is unmeasured. Warm = fresh sampler + shared-grid generation + encode; decode/checks excluded. Override-probe is a synthetic raised tile on flat ground, not generated country.
